## Rule  (DECODED + GENERATOR-PROVEN 2026-06-10, Worker-10)

Each grid has ONE fully-colored **pattern row** (the row with max nonzero ch1..9
count) + several **seed rows** that show only a 2-color prefix. The shared binary
`pattern[c] ∈ {0,1}` (same for every row) determines each output cell:
`output[r][c] = dark_r if pattern[c] else light_r`. Equivalently a pure
**column-copy**:
```
output[:, :, r, j] = input[:, :, r, f(j)]
f(j) = first column k with patternrow[k] == patternrow[j]
     = 0  if pr[j]==pr[0]   else   f1 (= first col differing from col0)
padding cols j>=W map to themselves -> stay 0
```
Generator `external/ARC-GEN/tasks/task_82819916.py`: `width=2*randint(4,5)∈{8,10}`;
`height=2*randint(3,7)`; `pattern=[randint(0,1)]*W` with both values present;
`common.random_colors` samples `range(1,10)` (never 0) -> `active==(prc>0)` proven.

## Algorithm sketch
```
row_nz[w]  = Einsum('bchw,c->bh', input, chmask=[0,1..1])   # per-row colored count
pr_idx     = ArgMax(row_nz)                                  # pattern row (first max)
rowsel     = Equal(iota30, pr_idx)                           # one-hot row selector
prc[w]     = Einsum('bchw,c,bh->bw', input, ciota, rowsel)   # col colour idx at pattern row
same0_b    = Equal(prc, prc[:,0]);  f1 = ArgMax(Not same0)   # first differing-from-col0 col
active_b   = Greater(prc, 0)
f          = Where(active_b, (1-same0)*f1, iota30) -> int32  # source col per output col
output     = Gather(input, f, axis=3)                        # [1,10,30,30]
```
No input-sized plane is ever materialized (the pattern-row read is a fused Einsum
marginal, #89/#93). Builder: `task197/prototypes/build_task197_gather_v6.py`.

## Cost analysis
Canonical 16,252 cost was NEVER the `[10,10]` self-sim planes (~1,600 B, what the
prompt assumed) — it was the **four `[1,10,14,10]` input/output planes** (~14,000 B:
F32 Slice crop 5,600 + masked 2,800 + output_active 2,800 + cast 2,800). The
Worker-10 Gather-index formulation eliminated the input-sized planes but still paid
three F32 `[1,30]` marginals because it detected the pattern row dynamically.

Aditya's 793 graph exposed the stronger generator invariant: the pattern row is
fixed at row 1 and width is only 8 or 10. Worker-6 v5 reimplements that route but
deletes Aditya's 400-byte `pat10 [1,10,1,10]` Slice by reading row 1 / cols 0..9
directly with a negative-pad 1x1 Conv (`pads=[-1,0,-28,-20]`). It then keeps the
10-wide index construction in U8 and casts only the final padded `[30]` Gather
index to INT32. Residual 278 = memory 263 + params 15; dominant tensors are
`idx [30]` INT32 120, `color10 [1,1,1,10]` F32 40, `idx_u8 [30]` 30, and several
10-byte BOOL/U8 vectors.

## Floor proof
No absolute floor claim. The old **~1,005 formulation floor** applied only to the
dynamic-row route and is falsified by Aditya 793 and Worker-6 v5 278. Current
residual lower-bound components are the final `[30]` INT32 Gather index (120 B),
the direct F32 row-1/width-10 color read (40 B), and necessary 10-wide selector
tensors for first-different-column plus active/padding handling. Sub-277 needs a
new fusion or representation that removes one of those charged tensors while still
feeding a legal INT32/INT64 Gather index.

**2026-07-09 (batch56, Claude worker).** LIVE is now **277** (Sho, 263 mem + 14
params, SHA `4f8eb859`, profile==static). An independent from-scratch rebuild of
the column-copy Gather formulation reproduced **exactly 277** (visible 267/267,
profile 277) — the floor is reproducible, not luck. The prompt's FreeOutput
Pad-tail direction was built and measured dead: free-output `Equal` on a
`[1,1,30,30]` label plane = **7488** (the free-output one-hot FORCES a ≥900 B
spatial plane the Gather route never pays); the `[10]`-index + output-Pad route
stays 12175. The single forced `[30]` INT32 Gather index is 120 B, already above
the prompt's floor_est ~110, so ~110 is unreachable in any Gather-index family
and no cheaper legal permutation op exists. Full forced-component argument +
dead-route table: `hard_records/freeoutput_padtail_sweep.md`.

2026-06-21 Worker-197-a checked the intended index-shrink route directly. A
`[10]` INT32 Gather index does save the `[30]` INT32 `idx` tensor, but because the
full 30-wide output still requires a final Pad, the width-10 Gather result becomes
a charged F32 intermediate (`[1,10,30,10]` = 12,000 B). The resulting static/profile
cost is 12,175, so the route is dominated by the existing final-Gather v5.

2026-06-22 Worker-197 checked the remaining obvious byte-level shaves. The 10-byte
`same_bool10 -> same_u8` cast is required because `ArgMin(BOOL)` is rejected by
strict shape inference. The 2-param `idx_pads` initializer cannot be removed with
Pad-10 attributes without dropping the graph to opset 10; at that opset `Equal`
does not accept F32 or U8 inputs. Casting the color strip to INT32 would make Equal
legal, but adds a charged 40-byte `[1,1,1,10]` tensor to save only 2 params. Current
best remains the 278 final-Gather formulation; this is not an absolute proof of all
possible representations, but every local sub-278 route found in this formulation is
either illegal or reprices above 278.

## Don't-do log
- **Path-A byte-equal (~360) is the WRONG goal here.** LIVE itself is buggy: 99.506%
  vs ground truth (fails the degenerate single-minority pattern `[c,c,...,c,d]` —
  the self-sim/MaxPool zeroes the 7 same-color columns). Byte-equal would import
  that bug. The shipped v6 is the DUAL-TRUTH more-correct-than-LIVE class (988 AB
  divergences = 988 LIVE errors, 0 candidate errors).
- Don't materialize the pattern row one-hot (`proh [1,10,1,30]`, 1,200 B F32) — the
  3-operand Einsum `bchw,c,bh->bw` reads its color structure with no plane (v3, -1,908).
- Don't use `MatMul(input, T[30,30])` for the column copy — T is a 1,800 B intermediate;
  a `[30]` INT Gather index is 120 B.
- Don't crop height (crop10 prototype is WRONG: max H=14, not 10).
- Don't use the old 1,005 floor as task-global. It is only the dynamic pattern-row
  formulation floor; the generator fixes the pattern row at row 1.
- Don't move the final Gather before a final spatial Pad for task197. The Pad is
  free as output, but its Gather input is not; `gather10_outputpad_v1` prices at
  12,175 with `gather10` alone costing 12,000 B.
